methods.label: Substitute the intersection point
methods.explanation:
The intersection point lies on both lines, so \(x=1\) and \(y=2\) satisfy both equations. Substituting gives
\[
1=\frac14(2)+a,\qquad 2=\frac14(1)+b.
\]
Therefore
\[
a=1-\frac12=\frac12,\qquad b=2-\frac14=\frac74.
\]
Thus \(a+b=\frac12+\frac74=\boxed{\frac94}\), choice \(\boxed{\text{E}}\).
